unlatched_review: Component 3 is the separate edge latch tongue at handle height, protruding about 5.6 mm past the leaf toward the strike. Keep its visual geometry and exclude only its collider for the common closed-unlatched push. Leaf, frame, hinge hardware, plates and handles remain collidable.
clearance_review: At 0.4% fitting attempt 000004 retains true source-surface crossings: leaf versus fixed hinge parts 8/9, moving hinge parts 6/7 versus frame 10 and fixed hinge parts 9/11/12. Source leaf and opening have coincident side/top edges. Test the documented maximum 2% uniform fit on the entire moving assembly: approximately 9.64 mm side clearance before the small latchward shift, 20.8 mm added top clearance and 29.0 mm total clearance below the leaf relative to the frame base. Do not accept until the complete collision sweep and previews pass; this is an explicit graphics-model fit, not a manufacturer measurement. A final 0.8 mm rigid shift toward the latch is tested to remove the residual 0.5 mm leaf/fixed-hinge edge crossing without exceeding the aperture or recentering guard; it cannot resolve the much larger hinge-barrel crossings.
